name: Career Finder Work-Style Assessment
description: A development fixture for the multidimensional assessment engine. Production 30-round legacy content must be migrated and reviewed before activation.

options.label: Help a team solve a difficult problem
options.description: Work alongside people and keep the group moving.

options.label: Experiment with several possible solutions
options.description: Try different approaches and see what works.

options.label: Take ownership and make the call
options.description: Move from discussion to a clear decision.

options.label: Organize the work into a clear process
options.description: Create a dependable sequence and keep details aligned.

questions.prompt: A project changes unexpectedly. What do you naturally do?

options.label: Check how the change affects everyone
options.description: Make sure people understand the impact before moving on.

options.label: Explore the new possibilities
options.description: Treat the change as a chance to discover a better approach.

options.label: Decide what needs to happen next
options.description: Focus on action and keep the project moving.

options.label: Rework the plan
options.description: Update the sequence, priorities and constraints.

questions.prompt: Which type of work would you rather spend time doing?

options.label: Investigating how something works
options.description: Dig into evidence, patterns or systems.

options.label: Building or fixing something tangible
options.description: Work directly with tools, systems or physical materials.

options.label: Designing or creating a new experience
options.description: Turn ideas into something people can use or enjoy.

options.label: Explaining or teaching an idea
options.description: Help another person understand and apply it.

questions.prompt: When you have several good options, what helps you choose?

options.label: Which option helps the people involved most?
Which option opens the most possibilities?
options.description: Choose the route with room to experiment.

options.label: Which option gets the strongest result fastest?
Which option has the clearest evidence and process?
options.description: Prefer a decision that can be justified systematically.
